plugins.description: Claude doesn't do its own stunts. Seven commands: /delegate work to five cheap worker backends (proxy, opencode, Codex, Antigravity, Muse), /relay across the 5-hour limit, /scaffold + /handoff self-resuming project memory, /wiki a cross-project second brain, /launch a go-to-market plan, /usages one board for every subscription's limits.
